Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Medium risk]** Build configuration for C\+\+ distributed tests with optional Python linking\. This PR appears safe to merge; both distributed test executables receive the required Python linkage when CuTeDSL is enabled. What we checked: - Both tests link Python: The file defines two executables, and the added loop links Python to both.

Summary

Adds Python linkage to the distributed C++ tests when `NVTE_WITH_CUTEDSL` is enabled. - Uses the same environment-based option and linking approach as the existing C++ tests. - Covers both `test_comm_gemm` and `test_ep`. - No actionable issues were found. detail.title: [Common] Link python to C++ dist tests with CuTeDSL enabled

files.patch:
@@ -56,6 +56,10 @@ find_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)
 find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)
 find_package(MPI REQUIRED)
 
+option(NVTE_WITH_CUTEDSL
+       "Link the tests against libpython, required when libtransformer_engine.so was built with NVTE_WITH_CUTEDSL=ON"
+       "$ENV{NVTE_WITH_CUTEDSL}")
+
 # -- NCCL core ----------------------------------------------------------------
 # Anchor on libnccl and derive nccl.h from the same install prefix so the
 # header and library can't drift across installs.
@@ -127,6 +131,19 @@ add_executable(test_ep test_ep.cu ../cpp/test_common.cu)
 target_include_directories(test_ep PRIVATE ${EP_TEST_COMMON_INCLUDES})
 target_link_libraries(test_ep PUBLIC ${EP_TEST_COMMON_LIBS})
 
+if(NVTE_WITH_CUTEDSL)
+  # Executables that link libtransformerengine.so must also link to the Python::Python to provide
+  # the definitions of these CPython symbols at runtime via dynamic linking.
+  # Find the interpreter too so older CMake versions use its version to locate libpython.
+  find_package(Python COMPONENTS Interpreter Development.Embed REQUIRED)
+  foreach(test_target test_comm_gemm test_ep)
+    target_link_libraries(${test_target} PRIVATE
+                          "-Wl,--no-as-needed"
+                          Python::Python
+                          "-Wl,--as-needed")
+  endforeach()
+endif()
+
 # Do NOT use gtest_discover_tests - these binaries require multi-process
 # launch via run_test_ep.sh, not direct single-process execution.
 message(STATUS "EP distributed tests enabled (NCCL EP loaded from libnccl_ep.so at runtime)")
